Condition : 1 - Commencement of development (Full Permission) - The development to which this permission relates shall be commenced not later than the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - Approved Plans - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Arboricultural Report Impact Assessment and Method Statement from RH Tree Consultants'
Condition : 3 - No Use of Flat Roof  - Access to the flat roof of the development hereby permitted shall be for maintenance or emergency purposes only, and the flat roof shall not be used as a roof garden, terrace, patio or similar amenity area.
Condition : 4 - The development hereby permitted shall not be used for any other purpose other than that incidental to the enjoyment of the main dwellinghouse known as 117 Cambridge Road, SW20 0PU.
Condition : 5 - The development shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved Tree Protection Plan (TPP882-C-ARB-03) and Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS882-C-ARB-04). 

The methods for the protection of the existing trees shall fully accord with all of the measures specified in the statement and shall be installed prior to the commencement of any site works and shall remain in place until the conclusion of all site works. 

Condition : 6 - Site Supervision (Trees) - Site supervision shall be carried out in accordance with the hereby approved Arboricultural Method Statement (AMS882-C-ARB-04). At the conclusion of the construction period the arboricultural expert shall submit to the LPA a satisfactory completion statement to demonstrate compliance with the approved protection measures.

Condition : 7 - INFORMATIVE
Note to Applicant -Approved Schemes
In accordance with paragraph 38 of the National Planning Policy Framework, London Borough of Merton (LBM) takes a positive and proactive approach to the delivery of sustainable development, by:
1. Providing a formal pre-application advice service, details to be found on Planning pre-application advice service on LBM's website
2. Providing written policies and guidance, which is available to view on LBM's website.
3. Where appropriate, negotiating amendments to secure a positive decision.
4. Determining applications in a timely manner including providing a fast track service, details to be found on Get a quicker planning decision on LBM's website.

In this instance:
i) The application was acceptable as submitted, and approved with an agreed determination date]
